> A full soundscape offers an immersive experience. I find soundscape to be a powerful tool for capturing the overall story and mood of a moment. I also love pairing each recording with a short note reflecting on that time - though what the sound ultimately means differs for each listeners.

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.sc-carousel').forEach(function(carousel) {
  var viewport = carousel.querySelector('.sc-carousel-viewport');
  var track = carousel.querySelector('.sc-carousel-track');
  var slides = Array.prototype.slice.call(carousel.querySelectorAll('.sc-carousel-slide'));
  var counter = carousel.querySelector('.sc-carousel-counter');
  var prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.sc-carousel-prev');
  var nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.sc-carousel-next');
  var index = 0;
  var total = slides.length;

  function update() {
    var viewportWidth = viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    var activeSlide = slides[index];
    var slideCenter = activeSlide.offsetLeft + activeSlide.offsetWidth / 2;
    var offset = viewportWidth / 2 - slideCenter;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + offset + 'px)';

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.classList.toggle('sc-active', i === index);
    });
    counter.textContent = (index + 1) + ' / ' + total;
  }

  function goTo(i) {
    index = (i + total) % total;
    update();
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(index - 1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { goTo(index + 1); });

  // clicking a peeking (non-active) slide jumps to it
  slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
    slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (i !== index) goTo(i);
    });
  });

  // basic swipe support for touch devices
  var startX = null;
  track.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; });
  track.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
    if (startX === null) return;
    var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - startX;
    if (dx > 40) goTo(index - 1);
    else if (dx < -40) goTo(index + 1);
    startX = null;
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', update);
  update();
});
</script>
